lessons.title: الدرس الأول: Life Styles
lessons.objective: أن يستعمل الطالب مفردات وحدة أنماط الحياة في وصف عاداته اليومية وأسلوب حياته.

questions.title: Complete: A person who eats vegetables and exercises daily has a ___ lifestyle.
Complete: My uncle works from morning until night. He has a very ___ life.
Complete: I go to the gym twice a week to keep ___ .
Complete: She follows the same ___ routine: she wakes up, prays and studies at the same time.
Complete: Eating fast food every day is a bad ___ .
Complete: On weekends, I ___ my free time with my family.
Complete: He is very ___ ; he sleeps late and never helps at home.
Complete: My grandfather lives a ___ life in a small village far from the city.
Complete: Doctors say we should ___ at least eight hours every night.
Complete: I usually ___ breakfast before I go to school.

lessons.title: الدرس الثاني: Grammar — Life Styles
lessons.objective: أن يستعمل الطالب المضارع البسيط وظروف التكرار للتعبير عن العادات، وأن يسأل عن تكرار الحدث بـ how often.

questions.title: Complete: ___ do you visit your grandparents? — Twice a month.
Complete: Nasser ___ breakfast at seven o'clock.
Choose the correct sentence.
options: I am never late for school.
I never am late for school.
I am late never for school.
Never I am late for school.

questions.title: Complete: My father ___ to the office by car every day.
Complete: We ___ go to the beach in winter.
Complete: How often does Sara play tennis? — She plays ___ .
Complete: ___ your brother work at the weekend?
Complete: They ___ eat meat because they are vegetarians.
Complete: Where ___ your cousin live?
Complete: My mother ___ tea in the evening; she prefers coffee.

lessons.title: الدرس الثالث: تمارين — Exercise
lessons.objective: أن يوظّف الطالب مفردات وحدة أنماط الحياة وقواعدها في حلّ تمارين متنوّعة على الجملة الصحيحة.

questions.title: Complete: My sister ___ television every evening after dinner.
Which question matches this answer: She goes swimming twice a week.
options: How often does she go swimming?

questions.title: Complete: Healthy people usually ___ a lot of water.
Which sentence is correct?
Complete: ___ your friends play football on Fridays?
Complete the dialogue: A: How often do you exercise? B: ___ .
Complete: My brother is ___ tired because he works two jobs.
Complete: We don't ___ much time watching TV.
Complete: Look at Huda! She ___ her new bike in the park.
Complete: I ___ up early, but today I woke up late.

lessons.title: اختبار الوحدة الأولى
lessons.objective: أن يبرهن الطالب إتقانه لمحتوى الوحدة باستعمال مفردات أنماط الحياة والمضارع البسيط وظروف التكرار والسؤال بـ how often في مواقف جديدة.

questions.title: Complete: "My cousin never exercises and eats fast food every day. He has a very ____ lifestyle."
Your friend goes to the gym on Sunday, Tuesday and Thursday. How do you describe this?
options: He goes three times a week.
He never goes to the gym.

questions.title: Which word is wrong in this sentence: "My father don't drink coffee in the evening."?
Which sentence puts the adverb "usually" in the correct place?
options: Sara wakes usually up at six.
Usually Sara wake up at six.
Sara usually wakes up at six.
Sara wakes up usually at six.

questions.title: Complete: "Ali does the same things at the same times every day. This is his daily ____."
The answer is "He works in a hospital." Which question is correct?
Complete: "Nasser ____ his homework after school, and then he ____ football with his friends."
Put these words in order, from the most often to the least often: sometimes — always — never.
Complete: "I usually ____ to school by bus, but today I ____ with my father."
You want to know the number of times your friend plays tennis in a week. What do you ask?
options: How long do you play tennis?
How much do you play tennis?
How often do you play tennis?
